name: office-town
description: Office Town — Cloudflare backend (wiki + files + publish + cron + dashboard + 4 MCP servers) hosted in one Worker

MCP_BEARER_TOKEN.description: **Leave blank** — the worker auto-generates a token on first request and surfaces it at `/dashboard/connect`. Only set this if you want to choose your own value. Rotate later via `wrangler secret put MCP_BEARER_TOKEN`.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: **Leave blank** unless you're wiring Google sign-in (next two fields). Generate when needed via `openssl rand -hex 32`.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: **Leave blank** unless you want team members to sign into the dashboard with Google. Default dashboard auth uses the MCP bearer (claim on first visit).

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: **Leave blank** unless wiring Google sign-in. Pair with `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` from `https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials`.
